notes.title: Hear comes new update!
notes.content:
[Updated Aug 6, 2019]
1. Five new mini-games have been added.
Now you can enjoy 40 games!!

notes.title: Many New games and New mode are Updated!
notes.content:
[Updated June 7, 2019]

1. Five new mini-games have been added.
Space War (Shooting), Pinch Hitter (Home run derby), Landing On the Moon (Balance), Attack Moles (Arcade), No Internet Connection (Run), which can be checked and played on page 4 of Normal Mode.

2. New mode Random5 mode added.
In Random5 mode you can play 5 games which are randomly selected in a row.

3. Balance and Bug Fix and Change uncomfortable UI

4. Screen filter added.
You can call up the pause menu during the game, you can change the screen effect to enjoy a variety of screen effects.
